label: Institutionalized anti-colonial women’s movement demands into empirical Women’s Studies
description: Building on the independence generation’s constitutional promises, Mazumdar led the Committee on the Status of Women to audit postcolonial reality.
dialecticalTension: Tests nationalist egalitarian ideals against hard demographic and labor data.

label: Institutionalized Indian Women’s Studies centers later transformed by Dalit feminist scholarship
description: Mazumdar’s founding of the Indian Association for Women’s Studies created the institutional arena within which Rege advanced Dalit feminist standpoint critiques.
dialecticalTension: Bridges state-policy feminist empiricism to anti-caste epistemological critique.
